title: Generic-fibre dominant field
statement: Let Z and S be affine schemes in universe u, Z reduced and S integral. Let g: Z to S be flat and locally of finite presentation, eta a generic point of S, and assume the eta fibre is geometrically irreducible. There exist a field L in universe u and a kappa(eta)-algebra structure on L such that the top intermediate field of L/kappa(eta) is finitely generated, and a scheme-theoretically dominant map j: Spec L to the eta fibre of g. The composite of j with the fibre projection is Spec of the displayed algebra map. No base extension, new base scheme, or separability assertion is included.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_generic_fibre_dominant_field
    {Z S : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine Z] [IsReduced Z] [IsAffine S] [IsIntegral S]
    (g : Z ⟶ S) [Flat g] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation g]
    (η : S) (hη : IsGenericPoint η Set.univ)
    (hgeom : GeometricallyIrreducible (g.fiberToSpecResidueField η)) :
    ∃ (L : Type u) (hL : Field L) (aL : Algebra (S.residueField η) L),
      letI := hL
      letI := aL
      (⊤ : IntermediateField (S.residueField η) L).FG ∧
      ∃ j : Spec (.of L) ⟶ g.fiber η,
        IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant j ∧
        j ≫ g.fiberToSpecResidueField η =
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (S.residueField η) L))
lean.note: 2026-10-20 (U): retired Sheaf twin Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.GenericFibreDominantField; points at its upstream twin.

proof.text: Identify eta with genericPoint S by uniqueness. The generic stalk is the actual function field S.functionField and is a field, so the residue map at eta is an isomorphism. The spectrum global-sections isomorphism and this residue-map inverse identify the sections of Spec kappa(eta) with S.functionField as algebras over A = Gamma(S, top). Mathlib functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen supplies its fraction-ring structure.

Apply isPushout_appTop_of_isPullback to the affine fibre square and translate the resulting categorical pushout using CommRingCat.isPushout_iff_isPushout. Algebra.isLocalization_iff_isPushout identifies the fibre section ring D with a localization of B = Gamma(Z, top) at the images of the nonzero elements of A. Since B is reduced, isReduced_localizationPreserves makes D reduced; isReduced_of_isAffine_isReduced makes the fibre reduced. This step does not require flatness.

GeometricallyIrreducible.irreducibleSpace_of_subsingleton makes the fibre X irreducible and nonempty. With the reducedness just proved, isIntegral_of_irreducibleSpace_of_isReduced makes X integral. Take L to be its actual function field X.functionField and define the kappa(eta)-algebra map by composing the global-sections map of the fibre projection with germToFunctionField. The fraction-ring theorem for the affine open top supplies IsFractionRing Gamma(X, top) L.

Locally finite presentation gives locally finite type, preserved by the defining fibre pullback. HasRingHomProperty.appTop and the spectrum global-sections isomorphism show that Gamma(X, top) is a finite-type kappa(eta)-algebra. Algebra.EssFiniteType.of_isLocalization and Algebra.EssFiniteType.comp show that L is essentially of finite type over kappa(eta). IntermediateField.fg_top gives the requested finite generation as a field.

Define j as X.fromSpecStalk at genericPoint X. Its image contains the generic point by fromSpecStalk_closedPoint, hence it is dominant by the closure characterization of density. IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant.of_isDominant applies because X is reduced. For the composite equation, ext_of_isAffine reduces equality to global-sections maps, and Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality together with fromSpecStalk_appTop reduces it to the defining composite of ring maps.
